The FoxFibre® Green Weft Selvedge is a 13oz Japanese selvedge denim that pairs indigo rope-dyed warp yarns with a naturally colored FoxFibre® weft. The distinctive green-grey tone comes from natural green FoxFibre® cotton that has been treated with iron, a traditional mineral-based process used to deepen and stabilize naturally occurring color. Rather than adding dye, the iron reacts with the cotton’s inherent pigment, resulting in an earthy green-grey tone that becomes more pronounced with washing and wear.
FoxFibre® was developed by cotton breeder and environmental pioneer Sally Fox, who began her work in the 1980s by selectively breeding naturally pigmented cotton varieties to eliminate the need for conventional dyeing. Because the color is grown into the fiber itself, FoxFibre® significantly reduces the environmental impact associated with chemical dyes and finishing.

The MIJ16 Genseki Selvedge is a 19oz unsanforized Japanese selvedge denim developed for maximum texture and character. Genseki translates to “raw ore,” a term used to describe unrefined stone in its natural, extracted state. The name reflects the fabric perfectly. Dense, rough, and heavily textured, this denim feels raw and elemental. Woven using slubby and neppy yarns , the fabric displays an intense, irregular surface with visible neps throughout. This yarn character is amplified through low-tension weaving , allowing the fibers to relax and shift on the loom. An earthy-toned weft adds warmth beneath the indigo warp, enhancing contrast and depth as the denim ages.
To preserve the denim’s hairiness, rough texture, and unsanforized character, the MIJ16 undergoes a Tempi treatment . This process shrinks the fabric while maintaining its raw surface and structural integrity, removing guesswork from sizing while keeping the denim true to its original feel.
The selvedge edge features an indigo–red–indigo micro-busted line . The narrower selvedge width allows the warp color to extend closer to the edge, with a fine red line providing subtle contrast.

The MIJ14 – Haru Kaze Selvedge marks the first lightweight denim in the Naked & Famous Denim Made in Japan line. Weighing in at just 8.6oz, this denim is crafted in a 2x1 workwear style using lightweight slub yarn. The result is a fabric rich in neps on both the warp and weft sides.
Made from 100% recycled cotton, the interior weft is dyed brown, giving the denim a warm, inviting tone. This denim is loomstate, meaning it hasn't gone through conventional finishing processes like anti-skewing, singeing, or sanforization. This preserves the denim's natural hairy and slubby texture, and over time, the legs will twist—a hallmark of traditional denim craftsmanship. To manage shrinkage, the denim undergoes a tempi treatment—a soak and hang-dry process that eliminates shrinkage while maintaining the crispy raw feel.
Finishing touches include a sheepskin leather patch, 100% copper rivets with hidden back pocket rivets, and 100% iron buttons—hardware that will patina and age gracefully alongside the denim. Additionally, the signature Naked & Famous Denim Made in Japan maple leaf embroidery is proudly featured on the back pocket.
